senses.gloss: † जष् जष्, i. 1, Par. To kill; to wound, v. r.

जस् जस्, i. 1, Ātm. (ved); i. 4, Par.
 1. To be exhausted, Chr. 296, 6 = Rigv. i. 112, 6.
 2. i. 4, Par. † To liberate.
 3. i. 1(?) and 10, or Caus., जासय, To kill, to strike, † to slight.
 --With the prep. उद् उद्, Caus. or i. 10, To root out (with gen.), Śiś. 1, 37.
 --Cf. Goth. qvistjan.
